dispute_ticket.description: I waited for the rider for 9 minutes at the condo drop-off point, called her, no answer, so I cancelled as no-show. The fee has been held and not credited to me. The rider is contesting it. Please release the S$8.00 fee to me.

chat_logs.content: I'm at Lobby B of The Sail, white Kia Carnival.
Outgoing call to rider, not answered (rang 30s).
Waiting already 7 min, will cancel soon if you don't come.

app_events.details: Rider R-7106 booked RYDE-PT-006 from The Sail to Sentosa Cove. Pickup 09:00.
Driver pressed I'm Here; GPS 15 m from pickup pin.
Driver in-app call, rang 30s, no answer.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event.
S$8.00 fee not credited: rider contested via RydeHELP, pending review.
The gps_telemetry export from the driver device is logged in UTC (timestamps ending Z); app events and chat are logged in Singapore time (+08:00).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The app event driver_arrived is 09:02:00 (+08:00) and the cancellation is 09:11:00, a 9-minute wait, above the 8-minute no-show threshold. The telemetry looks eight hours earlier (01:02Z to 01:11Z) only because that export is in UTC: 01:02Z is 09:02 +08:00, so it agrees exactly with the app events. The driver called at 09:06, messaged at 09:09 and the rider only wrote at 09:13, after cancellation. The S$8.00 fee is due and goes to the driver.
